University timetables done in minutes. Smart conflict detection, automatic assignment, real-time sync — all in one app.
Admins manage courses and assignments. Lecturers view their weekly schedule and mark unavailable hours. Each role gets a tailored experience.
After signing in we\'ll show you a tour tailored to your role — bulk-import hundreds of lecturers in 30 seconds, auto-generate schedules, export PDFs and more.
Welcome to UniScheduler! This quick tour walks through every tab in your admin panel (~5 min). Each page tells you which bottom-bar tab we\'re on. Ready?

📍 Bottom bar → \"Home\". A live snapshot: departments, lecturers, courses, classrooms, course offerings and schedule entries — all in one screen. Unassigned items are highlighted; tap to assign directly.
📍 Bottom bar → \"Settings\" → Departments section. Everything is grouped by department (Computer Engineering, Electrical, Industrial). Add yours here first — subsequent steps depend on it.

📍 Bottom bar → \"Data\" tab → Lecturers section. \"+ Add Lecturer\": title, first/last name, email, department. The system auto-generates a unique username (farhan_adl) and 6-digit password; share with the lecturer, they\'ll change it on first login.

📍 Same \"Data\" tab → Lecturers → \"📥 Import\" button. Pick your Excel file — the system processes 350 lecturers in one shot. Duplicate names are auto-resolved (farhan_adl, farhan_adl2, farhan_adl3…), passwords generated and downloaded as CSV. A dedicated cloud function bypasses the API rate limit — 9 minutes drops to 30 seconds.

📍 In \"Data\" tab add courses (code, name, theory/lab hours, credits). Then bottom bar → \"Classrooms\" tab → add classrooms (capacity, type: theory/lab/mixed). Bulk Excel import works the same in both tabs.

📍 Bottom bar → \"Assign\" tab → \"🤖 Auto\" button. The system generates 5 valid alternative schedules; preview each one. Lecturer availability, classroom capacity, conflict-free placement — all checked automatically. Approve the best — it pushes to lecturers\' screens in real-time.

📍 Bottom bar → \"Calendar\" tab. On the weekly schedule, tap the download icon (top right) to export as PDF or Excel. Use filters: full schedule, one lecturer\'s schedule, one classroom\'s schedule, or one department — whichever view you need.

Tour complete! 📌 Don\'t forget to share each lecturer\'s password — they\'ll change it on first login. 📌 Replay this tour anytime via bottom bar → Settings → \"Replay Tour\". 📌 First-visit tips will pop up on key screens as bubbles.
Welcome to UniScheduler! This 1-minute tour walks through every tab. Each page tells you which bottom-bar tab we\'re on. Ready?
📍 Bottom bar → \"Home\". Your week — day, time, course code, classroom. When your admin generates a new schedule, it updates live — no refresh needed. Long-press a class for details.
📍 Bottom bar → \"Availability\" tab. Mark days and times you\'re busy (e.g. Monday 10:00-12:00 meeting). Your admin respects these when generating the next schedule → no conflicts for you.
📄 Home — Export Your Week as PDF
📍 Top right of the \"Home\" tab — download icon. Saves your weekly schedule as a PDF. Print it, share via WhatsApp, keep as backup.
📍 Settings section below the \"Home\" tab: class reminders (15-60 min before), theme (light/dark/auto), language (TR/EN), and password change. Tour complete — replay anytime via \"Replay Tour\".
Walk through the app features once more.
Hundreds of Lecturers in One Click
All lecturers in your Excel file are added in 30 seconds. The system handles duplicate names, generates passwords and exports a CSV. Try it!
This button analyses all classrooms, lecturers and availabilities, then proposes 5 valid schedules. Pick the best.
Download the weekly timetable as PDF or Excel. Filter by lecturer or classroom.
Tap to save your weekly schedule to your phone as PDF.

Your home screen! A live snapshot of your institution: departments, lecturers, courses, classrooms. Unassigned items are highlighted in red — tap to assign directly. Tap \"Next\" and I\'ll take you to the next tab.

You\'re on the \"Data\" tab. Add lecturers and courses here. ⚡ The killer feature: the \"📥 Import\" button — adds 350 lecturers from an Excel file in 30 seconds. Duplicate names are auto-resolved (farhan_adl, farhan_adl2…), passwords generated and downloaded as CSV.
We\'re on the \"Classrooms\" tab. Add rooms here: code, capacity, type (theory/lab/mixed). Bulk Excel import works the same — bottom \"📥 Import\" button.

Here\'s your strongest feature: the \"Assign\" tab. The \"🤖 Auto\" button generates 5 alternative valid schedules. Preview each — lecturer availability, classroom capacity, conflict-free placement all checked automatically. Approve the best one, lecturers see it in real-time.
The \"Calendar\" tab shows the whole week. The \"📄 PDF\" icon (top right) — export with filters: full schedule, one lecturer\'s schedule, or one classroom\'s. Print or share.
Final tab: \"Settings\". Theme, language, notifications, backup/restore, password change. 🎯 You can replay this tour anytime via \"Replay Tour\" here. Let\'s wrap up!

All weekly classes here — day, time, course code, classroom. When your admin generates a new schedule, it updates live. The \"📄 PDF\" icon (top right) saves the schedule to your phone. ⚙️ Scroll down: class reminders (15-60 min before), theme (light/dark), language (TR/EN), and password change. 🎯 Replay this tour anytime via \"Replay Tour\".

We\'re on the \"Availability\" tab. Mark days and times you\'re busy — e.g. Monday 10:00-12:00 meeting. Your admin respects these when generating the next schedule → no conflicts for you. Tour complete, enjoy!
The settings section below your home tab: class reminders (15-60 min before), theme (light/dark/auto), language (TR/EN), password change. 🎯 Replay this tour anytime via \"Replay Tour\".
Tap the \"Data\" tab at the bottom. We\'ll manage lecturers, courses, and offerings here.
Now tap the \"Classrooms\" tab at the bottom. I\'ll introduce classrooms.
Tap the \"Assign\" tab at the bottom. Assignments and auto-schedule live here.
Finally tap the \"Calendar\" tab at the bottom. I\'ll show the weekly schedule.
Tap the \"Availability\" tab at the bottom. I\'ll show your availability grid.
Replay this tour anytime from Settings → \"Replay Tour\". Note: anything you added, deleted, or saved during the tour was NOT written to the database — you were free to experiment. Enjoy!
Replay this tour anytime from the \"Replay Tour\" button on your home screen. Note: nothing you did during the tour was saved to the database. Enjoy!
🛡️ Tour mode: this save was not committed to the database (preview only)

You\'re on the Home screen. A live snapshot of your institution: counts of departments, lecturers, courses and classrooms + unassigned items.\n\nTap the highlighted \"Data\" tab at the bottom — let\'s walk through the system\'s ecosystem together.

We're on the Data page. But before adding anything here, departments must exist — every lecturer, course and classroom is tied to one.

Department management lives in Settings. Tap the highlighted "Settings" button in the top-right; I'll take you there.

💡 Order: Department → Lecturer / Course → Offering → Classroom → Assignment.

We\'re in Settings. The top section is department management: \"Computer Science\", \"Industrial\" etc. are added here.\n\nType a name → tap the highlighted \"Add\" button. You don\'t need to try anything during the tour — we\'re just learning locations.

Departments you\'ve added are listed here. Pencil icon to edit, trash icon to delete.\n\n💡 Deleting a department leaves its lecturers/courses/classrooms with an empty department field — the records aren\'t removed, just orphaned. Double-check first.

Onboarding lots of lecturers/courses/classrooms? Use bulk Excel upload.\n\nThis card has three ready templates. Tap one → download → fill with your data → use \"Import\" on the Data tab to upload. Hundreds of rows in one go.
You\'ve seen department management and the Excel templates. Now back to Data for lecturer, course and offering management.\n\nTap the highlighted \"Data\" tab at the bottom.

I've opened the Lecturers section. The form above the highlighted "Add" button: title + first name + last name + department.

On Save, the system auto-generates a username + password; the lecturer changes it on first login.

💡 The "Import" button next to it loads many lecturers at once using the Excel template you saw earlier.

I\'ve opened the Courses section. The form above the highlighted \"Add\" button builds your course pool: code (e.g. CSE101) + name + theory hours + lab hours + credits + department.\n\n💡 Adding a course does NOT yet say \"lecturer X teaches it\". That matching is the next step — Offerings.

The heart of the ecosystem. An offering = course + lecturer + term + class year + section.

Example: CSE101 → Dr. Demo → 2024 Fall → year 2 → section A.

💡 The auto-scheduler works exactly on these matchings. Courses and lecturers must exist first, then combined here.
You\'ve seen the lecturer, course and offering side. Next: physical resources — classrooms.\n\nTap the highlighted \"Classrooms\" tab at the bottom.

The form above the highlighted \"Add\" button defines a classroom: code (A101) + capacity + type (theory/lab) + department.\n\n💡 The auto-scheduler enforces: course enrollment ≤ classroom capacity, theory courses → theory rooms, lab courses → labs. Excel bulk import here too.
Department, lecturer, course, offering, classroom — all ready. Now the most powerful part: assignment.\n\nTap the highlighted \"Assign\" tab at the bottom.

The magic — the highlighted 🤖 "Auto-Schedule" button. One tap solves all offerings and gives you 5 valid alternative schedules.

Conflict + lecturer availability + classroom capacity + theory/lab rules all applied automatically. Pick the best and approve.

💡 Manual: use the form above to pick offering + lecturer + classroom + day/time one at a time.
Assignment done. Last stop: the resulting weekly schedule.\n\nTap the highlighted \"Calendar\" tab at the bottom.

The full weekly schedule is in front of you as a visual grid. Use the chips on top to filter: by lecturer, class year, department or classroom.\n\nThe highlighted \"Export PDF\" button generates a PDF matching the active filter — filename auto-built (e.g. \"schedule-cs-year2.pdf\"). Printable, shareable.
You can restart this tour anytime from this highlighted button in Settings.\n\nLet\'s go to the last step — learning where the logout button is.

Safe sign-out lives here. Don\'t tap this now — we\'re just learning its location; sign out whenever you want.\n\n🎯 Tour complete. Nothing was written to the database — you can start with your real data. Tap \"Finish\" to end. Enjoy!

You\'re on your Home screen. This week\'s classes are here; scroll down for PDF/iCal export and settings (notifications, theme, language, password).\n\nLet\'s start with availability — tap the highlighted \"Availability\" tab at the bottom.

This grid shows every day + time slot in your week. Tap an empty cell to mark a busy range — e.g. Tuesday 14:00-16:00 meeting.

These go straight to the admin's scheduler: no classes placed there.

💡 Slots you already teach are red and can't be edited.
Instead of tapping the grid, you can also use the form: day dropdown + start/end time picker → Add.\n\n💡 Grid is faster; the form helps when you need precise time ranges (e.g. 13:25-14:05).
You\'ve seen the availability side. Now back to Home to show PDF export and other important buttons.\n\nTap the highlighted \"Home\" tab at the bottom.
The highlighted \"Export PDF\" button saves your weekly schedule as a PDF to your phone.\n\n💡 The \"Export iCal\" button next to it produces an .ics file for Google/Apple Calendar import.
You can restart this tour anytime from this highlighted button on your Home screen.\n\nLet\'s go to the last step — learning where the logout button is.
Safe sign-out lives here. Don\'t tap this now — we\'re just learning its location.\n\n🎯 Tour complete. Nothing was written to the database. Tap \"Finish\" to end. Enjoy!
Your weekly schedule appears below. The class you just assigned shows up in Monday\'s column.
